name: XinJiang Ba Yi Iron & Steel Co.,Ltd.
summary: XinJiang Ba Yi Iron & Steel Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the smelting, rolling, processing, and sale of various steel products across the nation. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses items such as hot-rolled coils, rebars, plates, wires, profiles, hot-dip galvanized coils, bars, and pickling coils. The company's headquarters are situated in Ürümqi, China, and it operates as a subsidiary of Baosteel Group Xinjiang Bayi Iron and Steel Co., Ltd.
